sub_sector.value: Nonperforming loan purchasing and collection; class action claims recovery

financial_business_type.detail: Purchases, collects and manages nonperforming loan portfolios and provides securities and antitrust class action claims recovery services.

revenue_driver.detail: Portfolio income from purchased nonperforming loans, proceeds from purchased class action claims, and fees for claims recovery services.

customer_type.detail: Banks and credit issuers sell portfolios, consumers repay debts, and institutional investors and corporate clients use claims recovery services.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Carries recovery risk on purchased nonperforming loan portfolios and class action claims, alongside fee-based claims recovery services.
